findings.evidence: Header provides navigation links to "Plan a trip" and "Accessibility"; footer provides "Privacy policy" and "Terms of service" links only.
findings.violation: The page offers only a primary navigation menu in the header. No site search, sitemap, breadcrumb trail, or other independent navigation mechanism provides an alternative way for a reader arriving from a search engine to locate this page within the site.
findings.fix: Add one of: a sitemap with link to it, a breadcrumb trail showing the page location in hierarchy, a site search form, or a related-pages section linking to similar transit update pages.
